cross_point_family_translation_diagnosti.note: Pure subtraction in saved residual arrays. No geometry is moved; differing proxy families have no established shared calibration target.

landmark_definition.thumb_caveat: Native thumb CMC [1] compared only to THJ5 base as a CMC/base proxy; not called an MCP correspondence.

limitations: Origin agreement confirms the implemented anchor convention, not anatomical wrist/palm equivalence.
Different models have no ground-truth anatomical landmark identity; thumb base and nonthumb MCP comparisons are declared proxies.
Axis comparisons are standalone geometry diagnostics, not an identified replacement rotation or calibration.
One MANO shape and reused development sources do not identify a general population calibration or independent validation.
A small point residual or reduced algebraic SSE does not establish preservation of surfaces, contact normals, forces or grasp success.
Palm surface bounds compare an open skinning-based subset with collision boxes; they are not equivalent anatomical tissue regions.
The pointwise residual decomposition never changes original targets, root placement, object pose, poor native proposals or historical labels.

measurement_policy.anatomical_pairs: Same anatomical names and base-chain roles define candidate proxies across different models, not certified identical anatomical locations.
measurement_policy.anchor: Native wrist landmark [0] versus Shadow palm origin; actual Shadow wrist body measured separately.
measurement_policy.common_frame: Native operator/fixed-URDF base directions R_world_MANO @ MANO_TO_OPERATOR_RIGHT.T; origin native saved wrist.
measurement_policy.proxy_axes: Longitudinal = anchor to nonthumb MCP centroid. Transverse = little-to-index MCP span projected perpendicular to longitudinal. Signed normal = transverse cross longitudinal. No palmar/dorsal assignment.
measurement_policy.surface: Native majority grouped-skinning palm triangle subset is open, includes assigned wrist-cap/mixed seam triangles and their boundary vertices. Its used-vertex bounding extents are compared with union bounds of actual eight Shadow palm collision boxes. Bounds/vertex means are geometric descriptions, not volumes or contact metrics.
measurement_policy.translation: Residual r=Shadow-native; rbar is algebraic mean over named proxies. r-rbar decomposes point error. Hypothetical -rbar is never applied to geometry/model/control. Across-source common mean uses operator coordinates.

scope: 32 existing native poses, four existing object families, eight observation groups; static original nominal targets only
